aggregate_runner_verdict.legitimate_production_backed_aggregate_p: YES, with the per-predicate condition below
aggregate_runner_verdict.question: A: does authority require the runner to invoke a production release-candidate or runtime entry point, or B: is it legitimate for the parent proof runner to orchestrate independently executing members that each execute actual production behaviour, with exhaustive and non-masking aggregation
authority_basis: No production release-candidate or runtime entry point exists in the repository for these criteria (searched app/ for one; none), so a rule requiring the runner to invoke one would be unsatisfiable, and no authority text states it.

STRATEGY_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACEABILITY_STANDARD requires an executable assertion for each mandatory predicate and forbids evidence that cannot fail; it does not require the assertion to enter through a production parent. The criteria (Backtest_Metrics_and_Acceptance_Criteria_LOCKED.md, "Replay and Data-Quality Acceptance Criteria") are claims over families of fixtures ("all ... fixtures passing"), which an executing aggregate over the family members proves by construction.
MD-B19-A001-002 (one guard pair proves a whole family) is the recorded defect this runner answers: the recorded pair checked that guards exist, and nothing executed them.

trace.G05 parent requirement: the nine predicates the consolidated package assigns to G05 inside the F-017 section, read by the runner from the package (a predicate added or dropped fails)
trace.aggregate proof boundary: per-predicate verdict computed from that predicate's own items; parent green only if every predicate is green; a predicate without items, without a current MANDATORY MD-B18 matrix row, or whose criterion no longer ends its row text is reported
trace.member proof: each item names exactly one guard; each distinct guard runs as its own real PHPUnit process; it counts only if PASSED with at least one assertion
trace.actual production behaviour: the members are the existing behaviour tests of the services and repositories; the runner copies no behaviour and stubs no member; neutering a production clause turned a member red in 51 probes

aggregate_runner_verdict.condition: The runner proves what its member sets contain. Whether a member set covers every clause of a criterion is a separate question the review answered per predicate; two sets did not (MD-S002-R0007, MD-S002-R0008). That is a missing member, not a defect of the runner or of the aggregation.

r0008_verdict.obligation: The criterion "corrected publications preserving their predecessors and switching atomically" is combined. Preserving predecessors is proven. "Switching atomically" is: Downstream_Data_Readiness_Guarantee_LOCKED.md ("atomically switches the active pointer ... Executed integration tests must prove ... atomic correction switch, concurrent reads"); Publication_Current_Pointer_Integrity_Contract_LOCKED.md (trade_date unique key, transaction discipline); Finalize_Lock_And_Pointer_Behavior_LOCKED.md.

components.MariaDB DDL uniqueness: not provable on the SQLite mirror; the member runs on the mirror schema (PK1 probe on the mirror). Belongs with MD-S003-R0025 (MariaDB, MD-DEP-0019).
components.transaction / atomic switching: service-level, provable on the mirror, and not proven: X1 leaves every guard green.
components.predecessor preservation: proven (SEAL1, READ1, READ2, PSF1, PUB1 each turned a member red).
components.concurrent reads: named by the authority; needs MariaDB; not proven.

r0008_verdict.is_sqlite_mirror_execution_sufficient: For predecessor preservation and the service-level atomic switch, yes in principle -- but no member proves the atomic switch. For the production DDL and concurrent reads, no.
r0008_verdict.decision: C: R0008 must not remain PROVEN. Returned to INCOMPLETE; the proof basis records the exact missing proof.
r0008_verdict.missing_proof: a guard that makes the promotion fail after its first write and asserts the prior publication still current, the pointer unchanged and the candidate not current, and that turns red when the transaction is removed (bounded, mirror-level); the concurrent-read and production-DDL halves wait for MariaDB and are owned with MD-S003-R0025

r0007_verdict.obligation: "long-chain ATR and corporate-action results matching independent oracles". The ATR half is proven. The corporate-action result is the chain event -> factor -> adjusted price and volume; the members cover the last two hops (factor activation state, OHLC coherence) with factors as input, and not the derivation of the factor from the event terms.
r0007_verdict.missing_proof: name AdjustmentFactorSetB11Test::test_verified_split_ratio_maps_deterministically_to_price_and_volume_factors (and any further factor-derivation guard the authority requires) in the R0007 criteria map, so the aggregate executes it, and probe it through the aggregate

md_dep_0019_verdict.classification: a required proof-environment dependency: the predicate MD-S003-R0025 cannot be proven until the MD-S003 acceptance scenarios run on MariaDB with no skips. Not a semantic or product dependency, not a governed external dependency, not a temporary local condition that a person would simply remember.
md_dep_0019_verdict.why_not_a_local_manual_prerequisite: DEPENDENCY_REGISTRY_STANDARD requires an unavailable external state on which a predicate waits to be recorded with an owner, evidence, impact, status and an exact resume trigger, and states that missing external state never authorizes semantic substitution. An unrecorded prerequisite would leave R0025 with no resume trigger and no owner, and would invite the mirror result to be read as the MariaDB half.
md_dep_0019_verdict.precedent: MD-DEP-0013 (MariaDB runtime availability, RESOLVED on observable availability); MD-DEP-0015 (database owner recovery decision, BLOCKING) and MD-DEP-0016. MD-DEP-0019 is narrower than MD-DEP-0015: it carries the resume trigger of one predicate and of the aggregate run, and cross-references MD-DEP-0015 for recovery and the full-suite criterion.
md_dep_0019_verdict.note: MD-DEP-0019 stays as issued. The R0008 limit (pointer-uniqueness on the mirror, concurrent reads) now also waits on it; no new dependency row is needed because it is the same environment.

f017_to_f018_progression_verdict.basis: E-082 proposed F-018 G06 because both remaining F-017 predicates were blocked. No orchestration rule or precedent was found that lets a finding stay OPEN and be passed over merely because its remaining predicates are blocked; the consolidated package and STAGE_EXECUTION_AND_REWORK_STANDARD keep dependency-driven remediation as one canonical resume point, and CURRENT_STATE was regenerated, not authority. After this correction F-017 has two actionable, unblocked predicates (MD-S002-R0007, MD-S002-R0008), so the premise no longer holds and the resume point stays inside F-017.
